s.g: A digital sound recording in MP3 format; a song file.
MPEG-1 Audio Layer 3, an audio data compression format.
An electronic device for playing digital audio files in the MP3 format and, in many cases, files in some other formats, as well as including a radio function.
An electronic device for playing digital video files in the MP4 format (and, in many cases, also files in other formats).
Any of a group of computer file formats for the compression and storage of digital video and audio data.
A computer file (as of a movie) in an MPEG format.
A viral disease, of primates and some other mammals, related to smallpox, caused by Orthopoxvirus monkeypox.
